sentences.en: In the 1880s, African-Americans in the South would hold Jive competitions, and the first prize was usually a cake.

sentences.en: We concentrate on ballroom and latin american dance styles, but also do some salsa, argentine tango, modern jive and much more!

sentences.en: Today, after much research, development and international agreement, there are five recognized "Latin" dances - the Samba, Rumba, and Cha Cha (from Latin America), the Paso Doble (from Europe), and the Jive (from North America).
sentences.vi: Ngày nay, sau nhiều nghiên cứu, phát triển và thỏa thuận quốc tế, có năm điệu nhảy ""Latinh"" được công nhận - Samba, Rumba và Cha Cha (từ Mỹ Latinh), Paso Doble (từ châu Âu) và Jive (từ Bắc Mỹ) .

sentences.en: The Bee Gees themselves make the largest contribution with six tracks of their own, although two tracks, Jive Talkin' and You Should Be Dancing, were hits that were previous releases from other Bee Gees albums.
